abstract: Between May 1990 and August 1992, 5 patients with advanced seminoma were treated with single agent carboplatin at Kyoto University. The mean follow-up period of all patients was 23 months. The clinical stage was IIA: 1, IIB: 1, IIIA: 2, IIIB1: 1. Three to 4 courses of carboplatin at 400 mg/m2, were administered intravenously over 1 hour without hydration every 3 to 4 weeks. One patient achieved complete response (CR). Four patients with a residual mass were observed, in two of them the mass disappeared and they remained free of disease. Two of the 4 patients with a residual mass relapsed 11 and 19 months after the start of treatment, and were successfully salvaged with surgery and adjuvant EP (etoposide and cisplatin) therapy. Subsequently, the overall CR rate was 60% and overall survival rate was 100%. The side effects of carboplatin were compared with those of VAB6 (vinblastine, actinomycin-D, bleomycin, cisplatin and cyclophosphamide), with which another 5 patients were previously treated at our hospital. Leukopenia and alopecia were observed in the VAB6 group with a significant difference (p < 0.05). Severe thrombocytopenia, dyspnea, skin rash, tinnitus and numbness were observed in 4 patients in the VAB6 group. However, no other symptoms but nausea and vomiting were observed in the carboplatin group. It was concluded that single agent carboplatin therapy for advanced seminoma was effective and less toxic, and it would be beneficial for the quality of life of patients, but the residual mass should be treated with surgery, cisplatin-based chemotherapy, or radiotherapy because it possibly has a recurrent potential; otherwise it should be carefully observed.
abstract_ja: 1990年5月から1992年8月までに、京都大学で進行セミノーマの患者5例にカルボプラチン単剤療法を施行した。平均追跡期間は23か月であった。臨床病期はIIA期1例、IIB期1例、IIIA期2例、IIIB1期1例であった。カルボプラチン400 mg/m2を1時間かけて点滴静注し、水和は行わず、3〜4週間ごとに3〜4コース投与した。1例が完全奏効(CR)を達成した。残存腫瘤を有する4例では経過を観察し、そのうち2例で腫瘤が消失し、無病の状態が続いた。残存腫瘤を有した4例のうち2例は治療開始後11か月と19か月で再発し、手術およびアジュバントとしてのEP(エトポシドとシスプラチン)療法により救済に成功した。その後、全体のCR率は60%、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%であった。カルボプラチンの副作用を、当院で以前にVAB6(ビンブラスチン、アクチノマイシンD、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、シクロホスファミド)で治療した別の5例と比較した。VAB6群では白血球減少と脱毛が有意差をもって認められた(p<0.05)。VAB6群の4例では重度の血小板減少、呼吸困難、皮疹、耳鳴り、しびれが認められた。一方、カルボプラチン群では悪心・嘔吐以外の症状はみられなかった。進行セミノーマに対する単剤カルボプラチン療法は有効で毒性が低く、患者のQOLに有益と考えられた。ただし残存腫瘤は再発の可能性があるため、手術、シスプラチン併用化学療法、または放射線療法で治療すべきであり、そうでなければ慎重に観察すべきと結論された。
